integrity: The left and full averaging equations are derived directly on all four ordered basis pairs, the automorphism group is computed independently from the multiplication table, and the orbit counts follow from the resulting one-dimensional torus action. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies representative finite fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies one canonical two-dimensional non-Lie Leibniz algebra, not all two-dimensional Leibniz algebras.
The source introduces the notions and induced structures; the concrete classification and finite-field orbit counts are additional.
An equivalent computation may exist under embedding-tensor terminology despite the focused searches.
title: Left and full averaging operators split sharply on the smallest non-Lie Leibniz algebra
